properties.evidence: The `verifies` helper in tools/assure.rs returns the bare "Invalid edge: VERIFIES cannot connect Verification to Decision" with no alternative, while create_edge for the same pair names GOVERNED_BY first as the modelled fit. Its description names 4 of VERIFIES' 7 targets and never GOVERNED_BY. So the modelled, read route was invisible at the moment the reporter reached for it (measured on 0.72.0).
